title: Rav Ahilai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Berakhot 25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.25b.24), Rav Ahilai (according to the reading of Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin) arranged his son’s marriage into the household of Rav Yitzchak bar Shmuel bar Marta and brought him into the wedding canopy, etc. There is also a Rava or Rabbah bar Ahilai: [Pesachim 30a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.30a.8).[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Berakhot reads Rav Achai. Hyman gives Ahilai from Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin. The consulted Pesachim has Rava bar Ahilai, beside the alternative Rabbah that Hyman records.
